title: Distinguish vanishing fixed-jump drift from its physical-time ratio
statement: On the same recurrent rank-two star at x_n=(n,0), the coordinator works out E Delta V_3=-(log n)/(6n)+O(log n/n^2) and E tau_3=2/(3n)+O(n^-2). Their ratio is asymptotic to -log n/4. The leading negative path x_n->(n+2,3)->(n+1,2)->(n,1) has probability1/(6n)+O(n^-2) and increment -log(n-1); leading positive two-jump excursions cancel on the third jump. Previously reported exact-Fraction finite diagnostics corroborate this asymptotic, not a universal theorem. A vanishing per-fixed-jump drift therefore does not itself obstruct a physical-time stopped-Foster route.
